title: Extension by zero equals direct image for finite etale module sheaves
statement: Let $\pi:U\to X$ be a finite etale morphism [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category] of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, and let $M$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda_U$-modules on the small etale site $U_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The canonical natural transformation $\pi_!M\to\pi_*M$ from etale extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension] to direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is an isomorphism. This is Stacks Project Lemma 59.70.6, Tag 03S7 (lemma-shriek-equals-star-finite-etale), for module sheaves.

mathlib_searches.results: No theorem for finite-etale j_! = j_* on small etale module sheaves; only generic direct-image and adjunction APIs.
